<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0042026-03-0408-49-24" status="reviewed">yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha 1</rs> na re <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">praM?</rs></note> mtshan nyid mtshon bya rdzas dang ldog pa 2 ga tha dad gtan nas med la | rtags 'dzin gyi tshad mas nog lkog shal ces pa blo'i rnam pa can du gzhal la phyis rjes dpag gis pa lang ces pa sgra'i rnam pa can du gzhal la | des na rtags dang sgrub byar kyang <expan>'gyur ro</expan> |
         <lb n="11a7"/> khyab pa nges tshul yang dpe' nag sgyur la tha snyad gsal ba'i gzhan rig mngon suM gyis nog lkog shal la ba lang gis khyab pa nges so || des skabs kyi nyes pa las grol ba ni dpe' la de ltar nges kyang rtsod gzhi' la tha snyad mi <choice><reg>gsal</reg><orig>gsa‹l›</orig></choice> ba'i gzhan rig gis mtshan nyid rtogs kyang mtshon bya ma rtogs pa de <choice><reg>rtags kyis sgrubs</reg><orig>rtags ‹kyis› ‹s›grub‹s›</orig></choice> pas rjes dpag du 'dus so || </seg></TEI>
